articles.summary: MARTINSVILLE, VA / ACCESS Newswire / October 29, 2026 / The board of directors of Carter Bankshares, Inc. (the "Company") (NASDAQ:CARE), the holding company of Carter Bank (the "Bank"), approved a cash dividend of $0.10 per share on October 28, 2026. Based on the closing stock price on October 28, 2026 of $30.22, the annualized dividend yield is 1.32%. The dividend is payable on November 23, 2026 to shareholders of record as of November 09, 2026. About Carter Bankshares, Inc. Headquartered in Martinsville, VA, Carter Bankshares, Inc. (NASDAQ:CARE) provides a full range of commercial banking, consumer banking, mortgage and services through its subsidiary Carter Bank. The Company has $4.7 billion in assets and 63 branches in Virginia and North Carolina as of September 30, 2026. For more information or to open an account visit www.carterbank.com . investorrelations@carterbank.com SOURCE: Carter Bankshares, Inc. View the original press release on ACCESS Newswire

articles.summary: MARTINSVILLE, VA / ACCESS Newswire / October 29, 2026 / Carter Bankshares, Inc. (the "Company") (NASDAQ:CARE), the holding company of Carter Bank (the "Bank") today announced quarterly net income of $7.8 million, or $0.35 diluted earnings per share ("EPS"), for the third quarter of 2026 compared to net income of $28.9 million, or $1.31 diluted EPS, for the second quarter of 2026 and net income of $5.4 million, or $0.24 diluted EPS, for the third quarter of 2025. Net interest income was $41.2 million for the third quarter of 2026, $40.0 million for the second quarter of 2026, and $33.7 million for the third quarter of 2025. Adjusted net income 2 was $7.6 million for the third quarter of 2026, $11.6 million for the second quarter of 2026 and $5.7 million for the third quarter of 2025. For the nine months ended September 30, 2026, net income was $122.4 million, or $5.53 diluted EPS, compared to net income of $22.9 million, or $1.00 diluted EPS, for the same period in 2025.
